title: Walk current-item hook: a compaction-summary record no longer starts a turn, and a test shows an item named in an earlier turn does not count
body:
Closes the three gaps that merge-lane-2's approving review of PR 1591 listed as follow-ups 1 to 3 (https://github.com/nedschorus/nedschorus/pull/1591, merge-lane-2's APPROVED review at head 695e9b13, and the mac-claude fix-round review 5555878337 it cites).

## What changes

1. **Earlier-turn case (follow-up 1).** A new case has an earlier turn that showed `Item 2 of 9` and a current turn that says only "Recorded."; the hook must send the agent back. It kills the mutant that replaces the turn's start with 0, which survived PR 1591's review.
2. **Dead test code (follow-up 2).** `SUB_STEP_EXTRA`, its `.replace` line and its placeholder in item 4.1 of the test's walk-document are removed. Nothing read them.
3. **Compaction-summary record (follow-up 3).** `turn_start` in the hook now skips a user record with `isCompactSummary`, so a compaction no longer counts as the start of a turn. Two new cases use the record in the shape real ned-box transcripts have it (a `system` `compact_boundary` record, then a `user` record with `isCompactSummary: true`, `isVisibleInTranscriptOnly: true`, string content and no `isMeta`): an item shown before a compaction in the same turn still counts, and an item shown in the turn before a compaction does not count in the turn after it.

Root cause: `turn_start` finds a turn's opening prompt by exclusion: it takes any user record that is neither all `tool_result` blocks nor `isMeta` without a turn-starting origin. Claude Code's compaction-summary record is a user record without `isMeta` whose content is a string, so it passed for an opening prompt, and a compaction inside a turn would drop the turn's earlier text from the check. This is one case of a wider pattern: any new kind of user record Claude Code writes for itself would pass the same way. Only this case is fixed, because the positive mark of an opening prompt, `turnOrigin`, is absent from older transcripts that the hook still reads, so exclusion has to stay as the fallback.

How often it happens: in the 62 compactions in the 20 ned-box transcripts under `~/.claude/projects/` that hold one, all `trigger: auto`, every summary is followed by a new opening prompt carrying `turnOrigin`, or by the end of the file; none is followed directly by assistant text. So the mid-turn case is a synthetic fixture, and no record shows the needless reminder happening. The between-turns case, the shape all 62 have, passes before and after the fix and guards that the fix does not swallow the prompt that follows a compaction.

The hook's text about answer letters is untouched.

## Evidence

- Red before the fix: with the new test and main's hook, the suite exits 1, 138 PASS, 1 FAIL: "an item shown before a compaction in the same turn still counts" (the hook blocked).
- Green after the fix: exit 0, 139 PASS, 0 FAIL, no SKIP.
- Hand mutants on the hook, each run with `scripts/run-suite-in-signal-sandbox.py --mutant` against the walk test:
  - M1, `turn_reply_text`: `start = turn_start(records)` / `start = 0 if start is None else start + 1` replaced by `start = 0`: **killed** by "an item named in an earlier turn does not count in the next one" and "an item shown in the turn before a compaction does not count in the turn after it".
  - M2, `turn_start`: `or record.get("isCompactSummary")` removed: **killed** by "an item shown before a compaction in the same turn still counts".
  - Survivors: none.
- `python3 scripts/run-all-test-suites.py --only-suites-whose-recorded-inputs-changed-since origin/main`: `SUMMARY: 21 passed, 0 failed, 21 total; 8 cases skipped in 6 suites; ... at 26975f63e8d6; Python 3.14.4; 139 suites not selected, their recorded inputs unchanged since d5e8d11adf80`. The skips are platform skips in other suites (macOS-only cases, no user scope bus, no en_US locale).
- `scripts/branch-conflict-check.py`: `VERDICT: CLEAN`.
